name: User login with email and password redirects to dashboard
description: An existing user enters their email and password on the login page, submits the form, and lands on the dashboard showing their footprint.

planSteps.description: Verify the login panel heading 'Welcome back' and the email input field are visible
Type 'demo@offset.io' into the 'Email address' input field
Verify the page navigates to /dashboard and shows 'Footprint Overview' in the header band or the 'Let's set up your footprint' empty-state heading
